title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 11: Finding Faith

scenes.say: His mother asks him to come to church. He says maybe. Then he shows up.
scenes.visual: a small brick church on a Newark street on a Sunday morning, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He sits in the back row like he doesn't belong.
scenes.visual: a man sitting alone in the last pew of a church, seen from behind, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: The pastor talks about a man who wrestled God all night.
scenes.visual: a pulpit with an open Bible, light streaming through stained glass, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Ali feels like that man. Tired from wrestling.
scenes.visual: a man's hands clasped tightly in prayer, knuckles white, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He asks the question he's been carrying since the courtroom.
scenes.visual: stained glass light falling across an empty pew, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text
a man looking up toward a church ceiling, light on his face, silhouette, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: No voice from heaven. Just a quiet peace he can't explain.
scenes.visual: soft golden light filling a quiet sanctuary, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He walks out lighter than he walked in.
scenes.visual: a man stepping out of church doors into bright sunlight, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Faith doesn't erase the past. It gives it meaning.
scenes.visual: an old bandana and a folded flag lying on a Bible, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: From now on, every scar is a sermon.
scenes.visual: a man looking out over a city from a hill at golden hour, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for Episode Twelve. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: church bells against a bright morning sky, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 11 of 25: Finding Faith. The true-story series from the book by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
